description.en: Thin wrapper around CMND_BTL_CONTINUOUS_BGM — temporarily overrides the match BGM with a given track for a match-side cutscene.
Optional BGM track ID to switch to (defaults to "").
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Override the match BGM with a specific track for a cutscene
ScEventContinuousBGMAtMatch("M_08");
